<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<title>MATRIX — Topic Intelligence Report</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
  :root {
    --accent: #4F46E5;
    --accent-2: #9333EA;
    --bg: #f7f7fb;
    --card: #ffffff;
    --border: #e5e5ef;
    --text: #1e1e2e;
    --muted: #6b6b80;
    --pos: #16a34a;
    --neu: #6b7280;
    --neg: #dc2626;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);
    font-size: 14px;
  }
  .page { max-width: 860px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 32px; }
  .header {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent) 0%, var(--accent-2) 100%);
    color: #fff;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 28px 32px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }
  .header .badge {
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: .06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  .header h1 { margin: 0 0 6px 0; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; }
  .header .meta { font-size: 13px; opacity: 0.9; }

  .card {
    background: var(--card);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 20px 22px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
  .card h2 {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: .04em;
    color: var(--muted);
    margin: 0 0 14px 0;
  }

  .tiles { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .tile {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 130px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
  }
  .tile .num { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; }
  .tile .lbl { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 2px; }

  .bar-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .bar-row .bar-label { width: 100px; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); flex-shrink: 0; }
  .bar-track { flex: 1; background: #eee; border-radius: 6px; height: 14px; overflow: hidden; }
  .bar-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 6px; }
  .bar-row .bar-count { width: 60px; text-align: right; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; flex-shrink: 0; }

  .post-card {
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  .post-card .post-meta { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .post-card .post-text { font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.5; }
  .sentiment-chip {
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 2px 7px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    margin-left: 6px;
  }
  .sentiment-chip.positive { background: #dcfce7; color: var(--pos); }
  .sentiment-chip.neutral { background: #f1f1f4; color: var(--neu); }
  .sentiment-chip.negative { background: #fee2e2; color: var(--neg); }

  .tag-cloud { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
  .tag-chip {
    background: var(--accent-light, #eef2ff);
    color: var(--accent);
    border: 1px solid var(--accent);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 4px 12px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12.5px; }
  th { text-align: left; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 11px; padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
  td { padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }

  .footer { text-align: center; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 24px; }
</style>
</head>
